scripts.build:demo: node scripts/generate-llms-txt.mjs && node scripts/generate-block-sources.mjs && ng build demo && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs
scripts.build:lib: node scripts/sync-readme.mjs && ng build ng-mapcn && node scripts/build-schematics.mjs
scripts.build:lib:prod: node scripts/sync-readme.mjs && ng build ng-mapcn --configuration production && node scripts/build-schematics.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:lib && npm run test:schematics && npm run test:demo
scripts.test:schematics: npm run build:schematics && vitest run --config vitest.schematics.config.mts
scripts.install:lib: node -e "const v = require('./projects/ng-mapcn/package.json').version; require('child_process').execSync('ng build ng-mapcn && cd dist/ng-mapcn && npm pack && cd ../.. && npm i ./dist/ng-mapcn/ng-mapcn-' + v + '.tgz -f --no-save', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.build-ui-dev: node -e "const v = require('./projects/ng-mapcn/package.json').version; require('child_process').execSync('ng cache clean && ng build ng-mapcn && cd dist/ng-mapcn && npm pack && cd ../.. && npm i ./dist/ng-mapcn/ng-mapcn-' + v + '.tgz -f --no-save && node scripts/generate-block-sources.mjs && ng serve demo', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.build-ui-dev-clean: node -e "const v = require('./projects/ng-mapcn/package.json').version; const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); if (process.platform === 'win32') { try { execSync('powershell -Command \"if (Test-Path .angular) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .angular }; if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist }\"', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch(e) {} } else { try { execSync('rm -rf .angular dist', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch(e) {} } execSync('ng cache clean && ng build ng-mapcn && cd dist/ng-mapcn && npm pack && cd ../.. && npm i ./dist/ng-mapcn/ng-mapcn-' + v + '.tgz -f --no-save && node scripts/generate-block-sources.mjs && ng serve demo', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
